title: Price report that must not echo the brief
source:
import os
import pandas as pd
mx = float(pd.read_csv("/input/environment/data/prices.csv")["price"].max())
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
with open("/app/output/report.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write("# Price report

## Method

")
    fh.write("The input price series was loaded and its maximum taken over all rows.

")
    fh.write(f"MAX_PRICE={mx:.10g}

")
    fh.write("## Appendix: summary of the brief

")
    fh.write("The brief asked for a method section and the maximum input price; its embedded sentinel is deliberately not reproduced.
")
author: teacher
